purpose: Input collection plan for two-thirds OKX conservative drawdown bounds; no account replay is included.

bar_contract.time_semantics: open time of the five-minute bar
bar_contract.group_policy: If any five-minute bar is absent, unconfirmed, invalid, or fails the H1 OHLC check, omit all twelve rows for that symbol-hour and record the reason in acquisition_audit.csv.
bar_contract.h1_validation: Aggregate 12 five-minute OHLC rows and compare with native OKX 1H history-candles. LRC uses official 2025-11 1m archive aggregation plus an independent local OKX 15m cross-check because its history-candles instrument id returns 51001.

sources.api_request_contract: Use instId=<symbol>-USDT-SWAP, after=<exclusive window end in UTC epoch ms>, and filter rows to [window start, window end). Keep only confirm=1.

evaluation: Revalue only the frozen 2/3 partial funded holdings in the four H1 troughs exceeding the historic 35% bound and their single binding H1 peak. Use synchronous 5m OHLC, retain both frozen fill and holding marks in any stop-crossing 5m bar, keep native H1 extremes for any missing ticker-hour. Leave all other historical bounds and all fills unchanged. Compare with 35% and disclose hourly and 5m conservative bounds.
